svg.title: Incubator
svg.desc: CO2 incubator with insulated cabinet, windowed inner door, shelves, sensor panel, water tray, and culture vessels. Biological basis: Cell-culture incubators regulate temperature, CO2, and humidity to stabilize medium pH and prevent evaporation.
